name: Themisto
axesStatus: Illustrative equal axes at a diameter estimated from brightness with an assumed albedo of 0.04; not measured.
credit: JPL Horizons apparent magnitude for Themisto (body 518); diameter estimated by cssEarth with an assumed geometric albedo of 0.04
shapeMeaning: Illustrative sphere at about 9.2 km, estimated from the apparent magnitude JPL Horizons gives for Themisto (21.843 on 2026-Sep-03, H = 14.3 with no phase term) and an assumed geometric albedo of 0.04. The size is not measured.
orientationMeaning: Illustrative ICRF north pole, arbitrary prime meridian and phase; no pole or rotation state is adopted.
surfaceMeaning: Unmapped surface: the standard grid is a coordinate aid, not observed colour or terrain.
introduction: Themisto is a small, distant irregular moon of Jupiter, only a few kilometres across. Its size is estimated from its brightness.
card: A small, distant irregular moon of Jupiter.
datasetSummary: A sphere about 9.2 km across, estimated from brightness with an assumed 4% albedo.
